thread:
maria_r: quick heads-up — after yesterday's kernel selector change i see odd KV cache hit patterns tied to seqlen. p95 for some small chat workloads spiked 20%
aj_lee: can you paste the profiling slice? is this only on the new kernel-routing path?
maria_r: attaching short snippet from flameprof:
```
# sample trace (trimmed)
seqlen 32 -> kernel_variant A (fast) -> cache miss -> kernel_variant A warm start 41ms
seqlen 128 -> kernel_variant B (memory-optimized) -> cache hit -> 28ms
seqlen 16 -> kernel_variant A -> cache miss -> 45ms
```
maria_r: seems like seqlen bucketing + kernel_profile versioning means cache keys don't match across warmups
devin_h: right — our current key is model_id + shard + kv_key. we don't include kernel_profile or sequence_bucket or runtime config. so different kernel picks can produce misses even for identical logical prefixes
simon_k: that's rough. consequences: more decoding work, plus thrash for short-seq bots. what are we proposing for a new keying scheme?
aj_lee: sketch: include a compact kernel_profile_id and seqlen_bucket in the key namespace, but keep a fallback lookup that ignores them for best-effort reuse. e.g. primary_key = ns:v1:{model_hash}:{profile_id}:{seq_bucket}:{kv_key}
aj_lee: fallback order: exact match -> ignore profile_id -> ignore seq_bucket -> global raw key. hits from relaxed matches have a confidence flag for metrics
maria_r: example pseudocode:
```
key = f"r1:{model_sha}:{profile_id}:{bucket}:{prefix_hash}"
if not exists(key):
    # try relaxed keys
    for alt in [f"r1:{model_sha}::${bucket}:{prefix_hash}", f"r1:{model_sha}:::${prefix_hash}"]:
        if exists(alt):
            emit(metric.relaxed_hit)
            use alt
            break
```
devin_h: we should be careful — adding profile_id explodes namespace cardinality when we have many kernel variants per model. storage + warmup cost could grow a lot. maybe we only tag profile_id when it's materially different (e.g., kernel ABI change or quantization diff). otherwise rely on seq_bucket only
simon_k: agree. define profile_id semantics: bump when driver binary ABI changes or kernel selection strategy switches major mode (attn-algo or quant-mode). minor scheduler tweaks don't increment. store profile_id in model metadata so we can invalidate cleanly
maria_r: what about persistence? current RocksDB per-driver persists across restarts but we need safe invalidation when model is redeployed with new weights. proposal: keep cache namespace version in driver config. on model deploy: if model_hash changed -> invalidate namespace; on config change with profile bump -> namespace rotate
aj_lee: also want TTL for short-living buckets and LRU with a per-model cap. and a periodic compaction job to merge small seq buckets if cardinality > threshold
infra-bot: deploy-checklist: add metric keys: cache.hits.exact, cache.hits.relaxed, cache.misses, cache.evictions, cache.cardinality.{model_id} — required for rollout
maria_r: one more thing — warmup strategy: on fallback-relaxed-hit, asynchronously rehydrate exact-key to avoid repeated fallbacks for same prefix. also surface traces in console with kernel_variant and key used
devin_h: sounds good. i'd like a small A/B on prod with 10% traffic: measure p50/p95, token cost delta, and storage growth over 48h. if storage growth > 15% we throttle profile-tagging
aj_lee: i'll draft PR for key format + fallback lookup + metric hooks. will add a knob to gate profile_id inclusion
simon_k: thanks. can someone own the rollout runbook? steps to rotate namespace if we mis-bump profile_id?
maria_r: i'll own the runbook. plan: feature-flag -> A/B 10% -> monitor metrics -> expand -> flip default. runbook includes safe namespace rotation commands and an emergency purge script
aj_lee: perfect, tag me on the PR. thanks all :thumbsup:
